educationalGoal: The learning objectives of this course are to acquire the following knowledge and skills as a foundation for chemical engineering: 1. Unit Conversions 2. Creating and Using Stoichiometric Equations 3. Calculating Mass Balances 4. Calculating Energy Balances
advice: It is essential in chemistry to express the necessary amounts of substances and energy numerically. Understanding elementary arithmetic, especially the concept of ratios, is indispensable for these calculations. Those who have not made an effort to understand the concept of speed in arithmetic, but have merely memorized the calculation procedure, will not be able to understand math after middle school, let alone chemistry problems. In this course, we will re-understand the concept of ratio from the basics and learn basic calculation methods for chemistry and chemical engineering using the concept of ratio. Understanding the concept of ratio requires effort, and there is no easy path to understanding it. Memorizing the answers will not improve the learner's ability. It is important to think through and solve the exercises on your own. 1.Unit Conversions 2.Creating Stoichiometric Equations 3.Calculating Mass Balances 4.Calculating Energy Balances
